name: Two conventional asset copies save references without duplicated geometry and restore exact IDs with shared resources
Unknown custom objects and independent instance geometry/material overrides retain complete legacy JSON
Mixed references and old added-only documents restore without inventing IDs or changing legacy fields
Reference validation fails atomically on missing definitions, incompatible versions, duplicate IDs and broken paths
Hierarchy edits, lights and instance buffers that exceed transform state fall back instead of losing content
Manual matrices, renderer flags and procedural children survive reference restore without extra registry IDs
